A haven of comfort and serenity, Tilenga Safari Lodge is set on the northern park boundaries of Murchison Falls National Park. It is located in one of the most breathtaking parts of Uganda just 1.7km away from Tangi gate on the main Karuma–Pakwach road. One has to watch out for its signpost a few kilometers before the Pakwach Bridge to not miss the magnificence of a place that looks out on the majestic Albert Nile.

We offer luxury tented accommodations and intimate cottages, each uniquely surrounded by lush bushland, providing an authentic safari experience in Murchison Falls National Park — one of Uganda’s most breathtaking wildlife destinations.
Each cottage and tent overlooks the Albert Nile, with panoramic views of Murchison Falls National Park, allowing guests to experience the untamed beauty of the wild from the comfort of their private retreat.
At Tilenga Safari Lodge, every stay is designed to immerse you in nature, tranquility, and adventure — offering the perfect balance between comfort and wilderness.
Our Accommodation Packages
At Tilenga Safari Lodge, we offer a range of accommodation options to suit your needs — each designed to provide comfort, privacy, and a seamless connection to nature.
Premium Deluxe Cottage
A spacious shared accommodation with a larger living space compared to the Executive Cottage. Charged per person, this option is perfect for those looking for comfort and affordability in a communal setting.
Executive Cottage
A cozy and moderately sized living space, offering a balance between comfort and exclusivity. Perfect for those who prefer privacy without compromising on luxury.
Elevated Tents
Set on raised platforms, these tents provide spectacular views of the surrounding landscape while keeping you connected to nature. A perfect choice for those seeking a unique and immersive safari experience.

About Us & Park Activities — Tilenga Safari Lodge
About
Tilenga Safari Lodge features 22 elegant guest cottages , comprising 11 Executive cottages and 11 Premium cottages , along with 2 luxury tents , all designed to offer sophisticated tranquility. From an architectural perspective, the River Nile and the park remain the central focus, ensuring that each cottage and luxury tent boasts a balcony or terrace with breathtaking, panoramic views. At Tilenga Safari Lodge, being captivated by these stunning vistas is an experience guaranteed.
A safari in Murchison Falls National Park is filled with unforgettable moments — whether it's embarking on an exciting game drive , taking a boat cruise along the Nile River , or witnessing the majestic Murchison Falls up close. From the diverse wildlife to the breathtaking landscapes, we ensure that every guest leaves with lifelong memories of adventure and discovery .
Our Activities
Chimp Trekking
Kaniyo Pabidi Forest offers the chance to track chimpanzees and other primates in a pristine environment of mahogany and ironwood trees. Six chimpanzee groups have been habituated, making for an exciting and rewarding trekking experience.
Game Drive
Most visitors explore Murchison Falls on safari, as the park is home to 76 mammal species, including lions, leopards, elephants, Rothschild’s giraffes, Cape buffalo, and hartebeest. The Buligi area is the best spot for game viewing.
Bird Life
Murchison Falls boasts an incredible variety of birds, with over 450 recorded species. The diverse habitats make it a birdwatcher’s paradise, with the rare shoebill stork being a top attraction for many visitors.
Hiking & Nature Walks
The vast landscapes and varied scenery of Murchison Falls National Park can be explored on foot. Trails through Kaniyo Pabidi and Rabongo Forests provide sightings of many primates and birds, while walks around the Nile–Lake Albert Delta offer possible sightings of the Shoebill.
Boat Cruise
A boat trip downstream to the papyrus delta at Lake Albert’s entrance takes 4–5 hours and offers excellent wildlife sightings. You can also disembark at a prearranged location where your driver picks you up for a game drive. Trips are organised by Wild Frontiers and UWA.
Fishing
The Nile below Murchison Falls offers thrilling challenges to anglers, with the chance to catch a massive Nile Perch — the record stands at 108kg. Fishing is restricted to designated spots, and spaces are limited, so prior booking is highly recommended.
Boat Launch to Murchison Falls
A must-do activity is the launch trip upstream to view the Falls and wildlife along the riverbanks. The round trip takes about three hours, but you can opt to leave the boat at Fajao Gorge, climb to the top, and meet your driver for pickup. Trips are run by UWA and Wild Frontiers.
Top of Falls
The most dramatic view of Murchison Falls is from the Top of Falls, where the crashing Nile creates an unforgettable sight and sound. You can reach this breathtaking spot by vehicle or a short half-hour hike from the boat launch.
